title: effigy.runtime-migration.v1 payload
description: Read-only report on the retired current-main central-store import. v0.15 ships only the v0.14.1 importers, which read legacy files on first use. The retired store, any cutover manifest and any old per-checkout import record are ignored: never read on a durable open, never changed, never deleted and never a refusal. The command never stages, imports, stops, changes or deletes anything.
